places.name: Nueces River
places.note: Drying out at their north-bank camp, Lorena gets her mare back from Gus; Jake slaps her for refusing San Antonio; Gus swims back across.
places.location_hint: Jake and Lorena's camp on the north bank, a short way north of the herd; Gus crosses south to rejoin the outfit

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Jake wants to gamble there a week; Lorena refuses to go back; Gus warns any lawman would search there first.
places.location_hint: reachable in about a day's push from the Nueces camp

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Gus says the runaway mare was heading home there when he found her.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande, south of the Nueces

places.name: Denver
places.note: Jake wants to gamble somewhere on the way there.

groups.label: Jake and Lorena
groups.hint: packing up camp on the north bank, disagreeing over going to San Antonio

groups.label: Augustus
groups.hint: swam back to the south side, riding through the brush to rejoin the herd
